messages.content: You are a senior security code reviewer.

Review function updateUserRole(req,res). It reads targetUserId and newRole, then calls db.user.update without checking requester permissions. Bug: requester.role !== 'owner' should be rejected. Also disallow setting newRole='owner' unless requester.id equals org.created_by. Required: audit event role_changed, rate limit 5 changes/hour/org, and reject if targetUserId == requester.id. Current code returns 200 for all roles.
Privilege escalation: updateUserRole lacks owner check, owner assignment creator-only, audit role_changed, rate limit 5/hour/org, reject self-change.
